extracted.summary: Rachel is a litigant in person in divorce proceedings seeking around £52,000 to fund representation, with roughly £293,000 of matrimonial assets (house and pension) in dispute and a hearing on 17 November 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for contacting Lodestar Legal Finance and for setting out your situation. So that we can consider your enquiry, we still need a few details: confirmation of where the proceedings are taking place (for example which court), the name of any solicitor you intend to instruct and their costs estimate, the current stage of the proceedings and what the 17 November hearing is for, and supporting information on the assets in dispute, including the house and pension values. It would also help to know your own financial position and any other funding already in place. We will review your enquiry once we have this information and will be in touch; nothing in this message should be taken as an offer of funding or as legal advice.
